paragraphs.source_en: Every word Honda Masanobu had spoken struck directly at what was in Ieyasu’s mind. Ieyasu even regretted having allowed Masanobu to speak. Ina Tosho was no cause for concern, but Hōkōji Jōtai could not be trusted. Though he now favored the Tokugawa as well, he maintained close ties with many of Mitsunari’s intimates.
